simple.meaning: שֶׁלֶט (sheleṭ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “probably a shield (as controlling , i.e. protecting the person).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 2 Samuel 8:7. The surrounding context includes kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שֶׁלֶט (H7982) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שֶׁלֶט (sheleṭ) / H7982 is traced through 2 Samuel 8:7, 2 Kings 11:10, 1 Chronicles 18:7, 2 Chronicles 23:9 with generated occurrence evidence.
